results.name: Its words stay readable in every state
results.says: At rest, contrast is 42 on the APCA scale at 14px. Text this size needs 60.

results.name: Its motion is quick and respects reduced motion
results.says: Its motion is brief, and it calms down for people who ask for reduced motion.
results.principle: Interface motion should be brief and say something; people who ask for reduced motion should get the same states without the travel. Motion that goes on while the control says it is waiting is a progress indicator, which may run as long as the wait, but it too must stop for reduced motion.

results.name: The effort fits the stakes
results.says: It asks for a deliberate gesture before a step that asks again: checkout asks for the payment itself, so a slip here costs nothing, so the customer is made to commit twice.
results.fix: Let one press open the next step; keep the ceremony for where the commitment really happens.
results.principle: Consequential, hard-to-undo actions deserve a deliberate step; everyday ones should not make people work. Both too little and too much friction cost trust.

results.says: Letting go early takes it back, so a half-meant gesture never commits.
results.principle: Starting a gesture must not commit you: letting go early, or sliding away, has to undo it.

results.name: Its motion is quick and respects reduced motion
results.says: It plays its motion even for people who ask their device to reduce motion.
results.fix: Honour reduced motion (states change at once) and keep a control’s own motion short.
results.principle: Interface motion should be brief and say something; people who ask for reduced motion should get the same states without the travel. Motion that goes on while the control says it is waiting is a progress indicator, which may run as long as the wait, but it too must stop for reduced motion.
